evidence.ACL: Complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance.
evidence.MCL: The medial collateral ligamentous complexes are intact.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Horizontal tear at the body and radial tear at the posterior horn of the medial meniscus.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Small radial tear at the body and large radial tear at the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus.
evidence.Medial OA: There is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury.
evidence.Lateral OA: There is osteochondral injury at the posterolateral tibial plateau
evidence.PF OA: the patellar and trochlear cartilage appears congruent without chondral lesion.
evidence.Effusion: Large amount of right knee effusion is present.
evidence.Contusion: Bone contusion at the posteromedial tibial plateau.
evidence.Fracture: Osteochondral injury at the posterolateral tibial plateau (about 1.8* 2.2 cm)
